description: Use this when estimating fence and gate costs from net non-gate length and gate widths. Returns calculated low, median bid and high bounds from exact City of Sunrise FL 2020 municipal bid rows, their scope and sources, and local permit guidance. Historical public bid observations are not current homeowner prices. (API Tool Calls, by Cowerx)

fence_type.description: Exact documented material and height row; no interpolation.

gate_type.description: Exact documented gate material and height for all entered widths; local_quote for unsupported gates.

gate_widths_ft.description: Each gate width in feet, not a gate count. GET: comma-separated widths; omitted means no gates.

net_length_ft.description: Net non-gate fence length in feet. Gate openings already excluded; do not subtract them again.

name: fence_cost
title: Fence Cost Calculator
